description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Austin / Central Texas market through PTF-AUSTIN-TX-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-003. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 154 of this market's 407 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Austin at 190 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 407 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-AUSTIN-TX-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the Phoenix-live hardened lineage -- the first Texas market -- refreshed under the repaired shared first-party reader by PTF-AUSTIN-TX-POST-READER-SAFETY-REFRESH-002, and registered by PTF-AUSTIN-TX-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-003. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 20 corridors over the admitted Austin-metro postal codes -- Downtown, South Congress & Zilker, East Austin & Mueller, UT & Central, The Domain & North Austin, Arboretum & Northwest, South Austin and the AUS airport at CORE; Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Lakeway & Bee Cave, Westlake / West Lake Hills, Buda and Kyle as CORRIDOR; Leander, Hutto, Manor and Dripping Springs as FRINGE. The destination Hill Country (Fredericksburg, Johnson City, Wimberley, Marble Falls / Horseshoe Bay, Spicewood, Burnet / Llano), San Antonio, Waco, San Marcos, New Braunfels and the careful-evaluation towns the evidence did not support (Bastrop, Elgin, Liberty Hill, Taylor) are named, refused and preserved: 0 rows are admitted from a refused postal code. A name decides nothing: a code binds only under its own brand, and two brand codes at one address are two buildings (9 such buildings are held, and 3 same-campus pairs the package contract cannot prove distinct are held outside the census). Timeshare and vacation ownership (Club Wyndham Austin, WorldMark Austin, Raintree), serviced-apartment products and rentals are never admitted, and a hotel whose own page says it has not opened never publishes. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 138 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 323 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 231 NON_LODGING; 969 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 11 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY.

reconciliation.note: 190 clean pet-friendly and 63 clean verified-no-pets over a 407-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, read by the repaired shared reader (an FAQ question is never an acceptance, and an explicit refusal always wins), bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one brand page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 154 identities did not publish (6 ACCESS_BLOCKED; 25 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 20 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 88 ROUTING_HOLD; 15 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in austin_tx_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/austin-tx/. 12 of 20 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
